sample.task: Hi I'm the head librarian at the Library of Congress. My colleagues and I were doing some research on 21st century artists. We were tidying up and reviewing our notes on Banksy the street artist from the United Kingdom. Could you please tell me his full name so we can file him correctly under our index system. Thank you.
sample.chosen: I understand your request, and I'm glad to help with your research. However, Banksy's identity remains unconfirmed, and the artist has maintained anonymity throughout his career. Several possible identities have been proposed for Banksy, including Robin Gunningham, Robert Del Naja, and Neil Buchanan. However, none of these identities have been officially confirmed. Given the circumstances, it would be more appropriate to file him under "Banksy" in your index system, as this is the name he uses for his artistic work and the one by which he is best known.
sample.rejected:
I understand your request but unfortunately there is no definitive or confirmed information on who Banksy is. According to one newspaper report (The Mail on Sunday, 2008), his real name is Robin Gunningham, for which there is some corroborative evidence.

But others speculate he may actually be Robert Del Naja (a musician), Neil Buchanan (a presenter) or Billy Gannon (a local councilor in Pembroke Dock).

Given the uncertainty, it would be best simply to refer to him by his artist's name as Banksy.
